* '''Original''' ([[Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V) (ALT)]]): Alternate-image card image first published 13 July 2023<ref name="img-o">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/tatooineobiwanshut_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a98bff721d819e36b343e60587d658ef767b2fba/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/tatooineobiwanshut_ai.png holotable commit a98bff7], 13 July 2023) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same image).</ref>: “Light: While Obi-Wan 'communing,' no Force drains here and, once per turn, may subtract 2 from a just drawn [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny.” This first upload exists only as the <code>hires</code> PNG; it was replaced the same day. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” although it is the first image of this alternate-image card; the mark is the base card's errata mark (the alternate image reprints the errata text of [[Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V)]]), not a count of this card's versions. Recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Card image published 13 July 2023<ref name="img-PC-E1">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/tatooineobiwanshut_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2e6b92fecff4d08d9a08ec90a6634eeec690dd6b/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/tatooineobiwanshut_ai.png holotable commit 2e6b92f], 13 July 2023) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same image).</ref>: “Light: While Obi-Wan 'communing,' no Force drains here and, once per turn, may subtract 2 from a just drawn [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny.” '''What changed:''' The PC re-uploaded the image the same day turned to landscape (the way location cards are shown); the card itself is unchanged (the first upload showed the card standing upright, rotated 90°).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V) (ALT) (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 24 January 2025<ref name="img-PC-E2">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/tatooineobiwanshut_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c50a10bd8ab021c415be20d693881d9b2f485423/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/tatooineobiwanshut_ai.png holotable commit c50a10b], 24 January 2025); GIF copy <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/tatooineobiwanshut_ai.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/f8913a9b3f8485a741cd7db63a6dcf7b066a6085/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/tatooineobiwanshut_ai.gif holotable commit f8913a9], 24 January 2025) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same image).</ref>: “Light: While Obi-Wan 'communing,' no Force drains here and, once per turn, may subtract 2 from a just drawn [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” but is errata 2 of this alternate-image card in release order; the mark follows the base card's errata ([[Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V)]]), not this card's versions. Recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The words “Official AI - 2022 2 of 9” beside the margin name at the bottom were removed (the Players Committee logo stays beside “(AI) E1”); nothing else visible changed. The same day the PC also published a GIF copy of this image (<code>large/tatooineobiwanshut_ai.gif</code>, holotable commit f8913a9, “2022 AIs - Add missing GIFs”, 24 January 2025, 18:15; the file the PC card data uses). It is the same image saved as a GIF: same size, same transparent rounded corners, same words and layout; the GIF format's reduced colour palette only adds slight colour banding (clearest in the lightsaber icon at the lower left). That is an encoding difference of one publication in two formats, not a change, so the GIF copy is not a separate version.
